slides.headline: The safety culture AI labs ignore
Top safety writer leaves OpenAI
slides.body: David Robinson wrote safety reports for every major model release. He resigned this week.

slides.headline: He says industry culture is broken
slides.body: Robinson calls Silicon Valley's 'extreme confidence' and 'perpetual sprints' dangerous for AI development.

slides.headline: Nuclear-level safeguards needed now
slides.body: He says AI labs must run like nuclear plants — with redundancy and careful planning, not speed.

slides.headline: Growing exodus of safety researchers
slides.body: At least 6 researchers from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind have quit and warned publicly.

slides.headline: Want the real AI risks?
slides.body: Follow for plain-English safety news that affects your phone, job, and family.
